verdict.rationale: CSC's own docs confirm it acts as registered agent in all 50 states, DC and international jurisdictions, which implies it supplies the agent name and address a filing needs. The evidence does not show an online self-serve purchase flow or same-day issuance of the agent details. The only 'same-day' claim covers SOP document delivery, a different capability, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: online purchase/checkout for RA service, documented same-day provision of the exact agent name and street address for formation or change filings, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
